paragraphs: I'm applying for the Financial Analyst role at Seso. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I like that this role owns the path from contract to invoice to cash to reported revenue, and that you want someone who would rather build a tool than repeat a task twice.

At Thomson Reuters I managed financial operations and cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of total inflows, and ran reconciliations with 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses on capital allocation that improved capital efficiency by 15%, ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget changes, and created AI powered dashboards that combined predictive metrics with financial projections.

That maps to owning the revenue model, tying it out each month and writing the commentary behind the numbers. I know agricultural labor and the H-2A program only from your description, so I'd have that to learn. I work plainly and check my own numbers, and I'd welcome the chance to talk about the role.
